assertions.subject: Lichen simplex chronicus
assertions.quote: Lichen simplex chronicus has been estimated to occur in approximately 12% of the population

assertions.subject: Lichen simplex chronicus
assertions.quote: The highest prevalence is typically from middle to late adulthood and often peaks at 30 to 50 years of age

assertions.subject: Lichen simplex chronicus
assertions.quote: The disorder is more prevalent in females than in males at a ratio of 2:1

assertions.subject: Lichen simplex chronicus
assertions.quote: Localized areas of the skin itch spontaneously, leading to an itch and scratch cycle

assertions.subject: Lichen simplex chronicus
assertions.quote: Skin with atopic dermatitis or atopic diathesis is most likely to develop lichenification

assertions.subject: Lichen simplex chronicus
assertions.quote: One study of lichen simplex chronicus with P-phenylenediamine (PPD)–containing hair dye showed improvement in symptoms when PPD exposure was stopped
